  -F image=@./portrait.png \
  -F audio=@./voice.wav
# then: GET /v1/task/{id}

faqs.q: Realtime avatar streaming?
faqs.a: These models are async render jobs, not WebRTC realtime avatars. Design UX around queue + progress.

faqs.q: Duix vs InfiniteTalk?
faqs.a: Different input modalities and billing units (per second vs per request). Prototype both on Keyo; see each model guide.

faqs.q: How do I try?
faqs.a: Create a key at /sign-up, then open /pricing/Duix-Avatar or /pricing/InfiniteTalk for interactive try/buy.
